38  class PostgreSQLExternalTestParameterLoadTemplateTest {
39      
40      private final PostgreSQLExternalTestParameterLoadTemplate template = new PostgreSQLExternalTestParameterLoadTemplate();
41      
42      @ParameterizedTest(name = "{0}")
43      @MethodSource({"sqlCases", "expectedCases", "conditionalCases"})
44      void assertLoadSQL(final String name, final String source, final String expectedEcho, final Collection<String> expectedSQL) {
45          List<String> expectedFileContent = expectedEcho.isEmpty() ? Collections.emptyList() : Arrays.asList(expectedEcho.split("\n", -1));
46          Collection<ExternalSQLTestParameter> actual = template.load("sample", Arrays.asList(source.split("\n", -1)), expectedFileContent, "PostgreSQL", "CSV");
47          assertThat(actual.stream().map(ExternalSQLTestParameter::getSql).collect(Collectors.toList()), is(expectedSQL));
48          assertThat(actual.stream().map(ExternalSQLTestParameter::getSqlCaseId).collect(Collectors.toList()),
49                  is(IntStream.rangeClosed(1, expectedSQL.size()).mapToObj(index -> "sample" + index).collect(Collectors.toList())));
50      }

330     @ParameterizedTest(name = "{0}")
331     @MethodSource("conditionValues")
332     void assertLoadConditionValues(final String expression, final boolean active) {
333         Collection<ExternalSQLTestParameter> actual = template.load("sample", Arrays.asList("\\if " + expression, "SELECT 1;", "\\else", "SELECT 2;", "\\endif"),
334                 Collections.emptyList(), "PostgreSQL", "CSV");
335         assertThat(actual.stream().map(ExternalSQLTestParameter::getSql).collect(Collectors.toList()), is(Collections.singletonList(active ? "SELECT 1;" : "SELECT 2;")));
336     }
337     
338     private static Stream<Arguments> conditionValues() {
339         return Stream.concat(Stream.of("true", "TRUE", "t", "tr", "tru", "1", "on", "yes", "y", "ye").map(value -> Arguments.of(value, true)),
340                 Stream.of("false", "FALSE", "f", "fa", "fal", "fals", "0", "off", "of", "no", "n").map(value -> Arguments.of(value, false)));
341     }

345         Collection<ExternalSQLTestParameter> actual = template.load("sample", Collections.singletonList("SELECT 1;"), Arrays.asList("SELECT 1;", "ERROR: foo"), "PostgreSQL", "CSV");
346         assertTrue(actual.isEmpty());
347     }
